Name: Custom NPC Gabriel mod
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
So uh, I made a [s]new[/s] mod instead of working on old mods. Sorry about that, guys...😅
I may have accidentally developed a raging hyperfixation with the Video Game called "Ultrakill" and its' characters. so I put one into stardew valley.
[size=1](and yes, he is romancable)

[/size][size=3]Current language(s): English.[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=4]REQUIREMENTS: SMAPI, Content Patcher.

[/size]I do not own Ultrakill or its' characters. this mod was made for fun, and I will not enable donations for it.
[size=3]

Please do not upload these files as your own mod.
Or post to any other mod sites.
Or post on sites behind a paywall/sell otherwise.
Do NOT use my mod to train AI.


[/size][size=2]This mod is compatible with AvalonMFX's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17819]Love Festival [/url]Mod, Gabriel will show up during the Festival if you have that mod installed.[/size][size=3]

Here's the requirements for Gabriel's heart events.
👇
[spoiler]
2 Hearts - must have two hearts of friendship with Gabriel, must NOT be winter, fall, or spring, and the weather must be sunny, it takes place in the Library/Archeology house
4 Hearts - must have four hearts of friendship with Gabriel, must NOT be winter, spring or summer, and it must NOT be a festival day. it takes place in Pierre's store.
8 Hearts - must have eight hearts of friendship with Gabriel, must NOT be a festival day, and the weather must be rainy, it takes place in the Saloon
[/spoiler]
